⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Data Link Layer

A 100 Mbps CSMA/CD network has a cable length of 1 km with signal propagation speed of $2 \times 10^8$ m/s. What is the minimum frame size (in bytes) required to detect collisions reliably?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Propagation delay $T_p = \frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Speed}} = \frac{1000}{2 \times 10^8} = 5 \times 10^{-6}$ s $= 5\;\mu$s.
CSMA/CD condition: Transmission time $T_t \ge 2 T_p \implies \frac{L}{B} \ge 2 T_p \implies L \ge 2 \times 5 \times 10^{-6} \times 100 \times 10^6 = 1000$ bits.
Frame size in bytes $= 1000 / 8 = 125$ bytes.

Two more exotic relational algebra operators are the semijoin (⋉)(⋉) and antijoin (▹)(▹). Semijoin is the same as natural join, except only attributes of the first relation are returned in the result. For example, if we have relations Student(ID, name)Student(ID, name) and Enrolled(ID, course),Enrolled(ID, course), and not all students are enrolled in courses, then the query "Student ⋉⋉ Enrolled" returns the ID and name of all students who are enrolled in at least one course. In the general case, E1⋉E2E1⋉E2 returns all tuples in the result of expression E1E1 such that there is at least one tuple in the result of E2E2 with matching values for the shared attributes. antijoin is the converse: E1▹E2E1▹E2 returns all tuples in the result of expression E1E1 such that there are no tuples in the result of E2E2 with matching values for the shared attributes. For example, the query "Student ▹▹ Enrolled" returns the ID and name of all students who are not enrolled in any courses.

🔥 GATE 2027 Original: Theory of Computation - Closure Properties

Which of the following statements is/are TRUE?

💡 Detailed Concept & Solution:
A is TRUE: $L_1 \setminus L_2 = L_1 \cap \overline{L_2}$. Since regular languages are closed under complement, $\overline{L_2}$ is regular. The intersection of a CFL with a Regular language is always a CFL.
B is TRUE: Emptiness problem for CFLs (and therefore PDAs) is decidable in polynomial time by checking if the start variable can derive any terminal string.
C is FALSE: Counterexample: $L = \{ a^n b^n c^m \mid n, m \ge 1 \}$ is DCFL (so both $L$ and $\overline{L}$ are CFL), but $L$ is NOT regular.
D is FALSE: DCFLs are not closed under intersection (e.g. $L_1 = \{a^n b^n c^m\}$ and $L_2 = \{a^m b^n c^n\}$ are both DCFL, but $L_1 \cap L_2 = \{a^n b^n c^n\}$ is not even CFL).
